question: Should this PR make OpenClaw own static Codex price defaults in the bundled catalog, or should it stay limited to recomputing generated zero costs from already-configured pricing?
rationale: The resolver bug is concrete, but built-in Codex pricing changes upgrade-visible cost reports and creates an ongoing ownership/update obligation that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Gate static defaults before merge
options.body: Keep the resolver and current API id, but remove or hold the static price table and extra fallback model unless a Codex/OpenAI owner accepts that pricing source.

options.title: Accept bundled Codex pricing
options.body: Merge positive Codex catalog costs after rebase and have maintainers own future pricing updates and release-note context.

options.title: Pause for pricing source design
options.body: Hold this PR until a canonical provider pricing source or update workflow is defined.

recommendation.title: Gate static defaults before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the resolver and current API id, but remove or hold the static price table and extra fallback model unless a Codex/OpenAI owner accepts that pricing source.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the Codex provider catalog and OpenAI provider identity contract affected by the decision.
